 Here’s the 2026 Singapore Black Friday cheat sheet—with exact dates, drops & top deals
 Amazon starts tomorrow, Harvey Norman wraps up early, and LG pushes past Black Friday weekend . Here's everything to know about the sales.
 Credit: Samsung / Canva 
 Save 
 Share 
 Megan Zara Walsh 
  –  
 Senior Staff Writer
  ·  
 November 18, 2026
 Add us as a preferred source 
 Planning to wait until November 27 to buy a washing machine or a sofa? Some of the best-known Black Friday sales in Singapore actually start earlier, and a few end before the day itself. From Amazon discounts starting on November 19 to Harvey Norman’s early furniture sale closing on November 26 (the day before Black Friday), and massive savings at fashion retailers and malls …you need to know about these deals before they disappear. 
 Black Friday lands on November 27 this year and Cyber Monday is on November 30 . Each store sets its own start and end dates, so here’s everything we know. 
 Black Friday sales dates 
 Here are the key dates of big name sales we know of:
 Samsung Singapore : November 7-30 (on selected products) 
 LG Singapore : November 1-30 (at participating retailers)
 Harvey Norman Singapore : November 12-26
 Amazon Singapore : November 19-30 (with flash drops at 12am, 12pm & 6pm)
 Uniqlo Thank You Festival : November 20-26
 Charles & Keith : November 27-30
 Some highlights include Samsung offering up to $100 off selected Mini LED TVs and $300 off the Bespoke AI Laundry Combo. Shoppers who buy eligible Galaxy devices can also redeem Samsung Rewards Points at five times their usual value, capped at $50.
 Meanwhile, LG offers up to 19% off selected home appliances across washing machines, dryers, fridges and kitchen appliances. Plus, some products come with gifts like grocery vouchers worth up to $100. Additionally, Harvey Norman’s sale covers selected seating and furniture.
 Credit: Amazon 
 Online marketplaces, fashion & flash drops 
 Amazon’s sale runs from 12am on November 19 to 11.59pm on November 30. Be sure to collect vouchers early and watch for daily flash drops . Listed discounts include up to 35% off Bioderma, up to 30% off Tempur, Speedo, Crayola and Hot Wheels, and up to 25% off KitchenAid and ASUS.
 Fashion brands like Coach Singapore start on Black Friday itself for the weekend , while Charles & Keith take up to 50% off selected items from November 27 to 30. Of course, we should see some sales from Lazada, Shopee, Zalora, Sephora, Decathlon and TikTok Shop. 
 Be sure to compare before you buy and purchase at the sales price only. Certainly, the best way to shop right before Christmas 2026 .
